decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the firm's established cheese offer and had its own page in 2019, which suggests results at or near aspiration, so in a growing industry there is little reason to start searching for alternatives.

The spicy cheese line with several models was promoted to its own page in 2019, signalling satisfactory performance, while the firm's pruning of weaker launches like A, B and F shows it already cut its underperformers.

The mild creamy soft cheese was highlighted at launch and given its own page in 2019, unlike the washed-rind soft cheese that was dropped, indicating it met aspirations and fits the firm's core organic dairy range.
